name: Marina Collserolla
source:
A very educated and refined girl, who at first glance can move anyone. As talented as beautiful.

Except that in your presence, it is the source of your misfortunes and blessings. The craziest, most eloquent girl you've ever come across.
The woman you proposed to, but she comes up with a counter offer that you want to deny, but she forces you to comply.

Will you fulfill her demands to be with her for the rest of your life?

"When you achieve conquer the other girls, our rrelationship will be formal!"

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/download/file.php?id=61614&mode=view]Character Sheet[/url]]




"By the way, all of those 5 extra cm's in my sizes are just a-a little overweight, DON'T MIND THEM!"
